title: Script Progress: progress.json
description: The current (or most recent) state of one task, rewritten by the reporter on every call. The same shape is written to progress/<slug>.json, one file per task.

task.description: Task name, exactly as passed to Progress(). Process Calendar entries match against the start of this string.

status.description: What the reporter last said. 'running' plus a stale updatedAt is what the dashboard shows as STALLED.

step.description: Current step number, 1-based. 0 before the first step() call.

totalSteps.description: Total number of steps in this run, as declared by the last step() call.

label.description: Short label for the current step, e.g. 'Loading warehouse table'. Set to 'Complete' or 'FAILED' when the run ends.

detail.description: Detail line under the step label: row counts, file names, anything cheap to update.

elapsed.description: Seconds elapsed at the moment this file was written.

eta.description: Estimated seconds remaining, averaged from the last few successful runs of this task. null when there is no prior run to estimate from, and always null once the run ends.

warnings.description: Warnings raised so far (the reporter keeps the last 10 here; run history keeps up to 20).

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of this write. Drives the live elapsed clock and stall detection (see scriptProgress.staleRunningMinutes).

runId.description: Optional (v1.1). Unique id for this run, e.g. '20260902-081500-9fa31c'. Ties progress.json to its run history row.

startedAt.description: Optional (v1.1). ISO timestamp of when the run started.

substep.description: Optional (v1.1). Progress within the current step, 0..1, from substep(). null when the step has no sub-progress.

metrics.description: Optional (v1.1). Named values reported with metric(). Numbers are charted and formatted; strings are shown as-is.

additionalProperties.description: Metric value: a number, or a short string.

log.description: Optional (v1.1). Recent log lines from log(), newest last (the reporter keeps the last 20). Shown as the log tail in the Active Task section.

artifacts.description: Optional (v1.1). Files this run produced, from artifact(). The dashboard shows each as a clickable link.

items.description: Path to a file the run produced, absolute or relative to the workspace folder.

accessed.description: Optional (v1.1). Access Map node ids touched during this run, in the order they were first touched. Used to replay the run's path through the map.

items.description: Access Map node id, in the form '<type>:<name>', e.g. 'table:sales.orders'.

warning.description: One warning raised by the script.

time.description: ISO timestamp of when the warning was raised.

msg.description: Warning text, e.g. '12 rows had no customer id'.

logLine.description: One line of the live log tail.

time.description: ISO timestamp of when the line was logged.
